_about: Display-only merged group pages, edited by hand (src/propose_merged_groups.py only proposes). A page shows 2 to 8 groups together as sections ordered by trust (precise, tentative, tag, loose, 'also here'); the FIRST member listed is the page's key and must be the highest in trust order (then the largest); the other members' keys redirect to the page. No group id, placement, count or figure changes: every group keeps its own id, its own count and its own placements, and the number a page shows (the union) is a display figure, a card in two groups counted once. 'aliases' are extra search terms for the page (the members' names are searched anyway). 'member_notes' (optional) maps a member id to a note shown in that section's heading. A page's slug is chosen once and never reused: to stop merging a page set 'retired': true (the entry stays; deleting it is an error on the next build). Version 1 supports leaf and community-tag (tag:) members only; any other layer fails the build. Append new pages; do not reorder or edit old ones except to retire them.

draw-cards.name: Draw cards
draw-cards.description: Cards that draw cards. Kept as three groups because the parser could not always record who draws; each section below says how it differs.
draw-cards.basis: name-twins: the same name once the qualifiers are removed (qualifiers are parser limits only)

gain-life.name: Gain life
gain-life.description: Cards that gain life. The second group is only the cases where the parser could not tell who gains it.

counter-a-spell.name: Counter a spell
counter-a-spell.description: Counterspells. The second group is the ones that counter only some spells (a restriction the parser records as 'object varies').

damage-to-a-creature.name: Deal damage to a creature
damage-to-a-creature.description: Cards that deal damage to a creature. The second group adds a 'this turn' condition (a creature that blocked, or was dealt damage, this turn).

counters-on-this-permanent.name: Put +1/+1 counters on this permanent
counters-on-this-permanent.description: Cards that put +1/+1 counters on themselves. The second group counts something 'this turn'.

creature-gets-plus-until-eot.name: A creature gets +N/+N until end of turn
creature-gets-plus-until-eot.description: Pump effects on a creature for the turn. The smaller group is the ones where the parser could not say what the target is.

create-creature-tokens.name: Create creature tokens
create-creature-tokens.description: Cards that create creature tokens. The smaller groups are 'for each ...' counts and 'this turn' conditions, not temporary tokens.

set-power-and-toughness.name: This permanent has set power and toughness
set-power-and-toughness.description: Characteristic-defining abilities: power and toughness (or power alone) set by a count. Two groups with the same name, one of which also holds power-only cards.

creature-gets-minus-until-eot.name: A creature gets −N/−N until end of turn
creature-gets-minus-until-eot.description: Shrink effects on a creature for the turn. The smaller group is the ones where the parser could not say what the target is.

destroy-a-creature.name: Destroy a creature
destroy-a-creature.description: Cards that destroy a creature. The smaller groups are 'excluding some kind' and 'that was dealt damage this turn'.

copies-instants-and-sorceries.name: Copies an instant or a sorcery
copies-instants-and-sorceries.description: Cards that copy an instant spell or a sorcery spell. The community tags "Copies sorcery" and "Copies instant" hold the same 11 cards.
copies-instants-and-sorceries.basis: hand-confirmed near-duplicate (11 of 11 cards in common)

draw-engines.name: Draw engine: draws a card again and again
draw-engines.description: Cards that draw more cards over and over. "Draws a card again and again with no other cost" is all of its 31 cards inside "Draw engine" (36).

raises-power-of-your-creatures.name: Raises the power of your creatures
raises-power-of-your-creatures.description: Cards that raise the power of all your creatures, or of a type. "Gives your whole team +N/+N" is 10 cards, all inside "Raises the power of your creatures" (13).
